description: Unsigned transactions to buy options from the best ask of a series (or a given ask with order_id), checked on chain: exact approval of the premium, then fillAsk with that premium as the most it may take. A fill takes the whole ask or leaves at least 0.001 of a share. Returns the cost, Borro's share, the break-even and what it pays at expiry.

expiry.description: this (default), next, or a Friday's date like 2026-10-16

max_premium.description: The most to pay in all, USDG (optional), in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

order_id.description: Buy from this ask instead of the best one

shares.description: Shares to buy, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: buy_option
title: Prepare: buy a call or a put
